payload.title: Pass tail-safe 25 percent surface projection to live parity
payload.decision: Accept T062 as a local validation pass and authorize exact live notebook parity tests at fixed degree 4, 25% projection, 75% raw retention, Savitzky-Golay window 51, 500 ft warm-up, and 25 ft cap. Do not infer leaderboard performance.
payload.rationale: The exact action improved every registered base, spatial cell and fold cell and passed the frozen tail and bootstrap gates that rejected 50% projection.
payload.revisit_trigger: Reject deployment if live source lineage, fallbacks, action cap, ID order, finiteness, deterministic replay, or local/Kaggle parity fails; otherwise submit only under explicit authorization.
